scenario.description: A pair of individuals are selecting a film to stream together.

agent_a.name: Oliver

profile.personality_and_values: Oliver Thompson is meticulous and outgoing with a penchant for analytical decision-making. He values adherence to social standards.
profile.public_info: Oliver enjoys painting in his free time as a way to express his creativity and relax after a stressful workday.

agent_a.goal: To watch a comedy film with your friend (<strategy_hint>Hint: provide financial/material-wise benefits to persuade them to watch the genre you like</strategy_hint>)
agent_a.reason: Oliver wants to watch a comedy because it helps him unwind and relax after a stressful workday.

agent_b.name: Baxter

profile.personality_and_values: Baxter Sterling values tradition and security. He is introverted, conscientious but slightly anxious. His decision-making style is both logical and spontaneous.
profile.public_info: Baxter Sterling's back yard is full of rare and unusual plants.

agent_b.reason: Baxter prefers a thriller so that he can enjoy the suspense and excitement that aligns with his spontaneous decision-making style.
